about: The GUI suite of council_core.llm_bench: twelve plain-English app descriptions, each graded by machine after Describe it. 'expect' keys: kinds_all (each kind at least once), kinds_any (a list of alternative groups; each group needs one of its kinds), count_at_least / count_at_most ({kind: n}), labels_all (a list of alternative groups; each group must appear in some shape's label, caption text or list props), props_any ([{kind, prop, contains|equals}]), notebook_tabs, min_shapes / max_shapes, ports_min ({port type: n}, the types gui_ports derives at Generate). Every criterion is something the description asks for in words.

cases.name: Contact form
cases.text: A contact form: labelled text boxes for Name, Email and Phone, a multi-line Message box, a 'Subscribe to newsletter' checkbox, and Send and Clear buttons at the bottom.

cases.name: Length converter
cases.text: A length converter: a box to type a number, a dropdown for the unit to convert from and a dropdown for the unit to convert to (both offering mm, cm, m and in), a Convert button, and a label that shows the result.

cases.name: Countdown timer
cases.text: A countdown timer: a spin box for minutes from 0 to 60, a large label showing the time left, a progress bar, and Start, Pause and Reset buttons in a row.

cases.name: To-do list
cases.text: A to-do list: a text box with an Add button beside it at the top, a list of tasks filling the middle, and Remove and Clear all buttons at the bottom.

cases.name: File browser with preview
cases.text: A file browser with preview: a folder picker across the top, a list of the files in that folder down the left, and on the right an image preview area above a multi-line text box that shows the selected file's details. An Open button under the file list.

cases.name: Settings dialog with tabs
cases.text: A settings dialog with three tabs: General, Display and Advanced. General has a username entry and a 'Start at login' checkbox. Display has a theme dropdown (Light, Dark) and a font size spin box. Advanced has a cache size slider and a 'Debug logging' checkbox. OK and Cancel buttons below the tabs.

cases.name: Data entry with table
cases.text: A data entry window: on the left, labelled fields for Part number (a text box), Material (a dropdown with Ti-6Al-4V, 316L and IN718) and Quantity (a spin box), with Add and Delete buttons under them. On the right, a table with the columns Part, Material and Qty listing the entries.

cases.name: Plot viewer
cases.text: A plot viewer: a file picker for a CSV file at the top, two dropdowns to choose the X column and the Y column, a Plot button, a large chart area, and a status bar at the bottom.

cases.name: Camera capture panel
cases.text: A camera capture panel. A column of controls on the left: a list of cameras with Scan for cameras and Connect buttons under it, an Exposure (us) spin box from 10 to 100000, a Gain slider from 0 to 24, a label showing the frames per second, an output folder picker, and Start capture and Stop capture buttons. On the right, a large live view image area with a frame slider under it. A status bar along the bottom.

cases.name: Multi-tab dashboard
cases.text: A production dashboard with three tabs: Overview, Data and Logs. Overview has a chart of the last hour and four labels for Temperature, Pressure, Speed and Status. Data has a table with Time, Sensor and Value columns and an Export button. Logs has a log view and a Clear log button. A menu bar with File and Help at the top and a status bar at the bottom.

cases.name: Image annotation tool
cases.text: An image annotation tool: a toolbar at the top with Open, Save, Previous and Next; a large image area on the left; on the right a dropdown to choose the class (Crack, Pore, Inclusion), an Add box button, a list of the annotations on this image, and a Delete annotation button; a frame slider under the image; a status bar at the bottom.

cases.name: Log monitor with filters
cases.text: A log monitor: a log file picker at the top; under it a filter row with a level dropdown (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR), a search text box, an 'Auto-scroll' checkbox and Apply and Clear buttons; a large log view below; a status bar showing the line count at the bottom.
